articles.title: RTX's BBN Technologies launches open-source tool to validate covert cyber networks
articles.mainIdea: RTX's BBN Technologies launches open-source tool to validate covert cyber networks
articles.summary: PR Newswire: RTX's BBN Technologies launches open-source tool to validate covert cyber networks. RTX's (NYSE: RTX) BBN Technologies has released Maude-HCS, an open-source toolkit that enables cyber defense teams to model, test and validate covert communication networks. Funded by the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) under its PWND2 program, the toolkit is available on GitHub and provides fast, reliable and scalable performance, allowing teams to accelerate innovation, validate designs and deploy in real-world environments.
